dict.string: HumID uses the camera to scan HumID QR codes and to photograph documents and IDs you add to your vault. Photos are sealed on this device; nothing is recorded otherwise.
HumID can stamp a document with where it was sealed, if you leave "Stamp where it's sealed" on. The location is sealed with the document's name on this device; the vault server can't read it.
